summary: Standards: scenario 85 ('results, level and exit code are the same with findings as without') is bound to a test that asserts fixed expected values for four tools (pass, MUST fail, SHOULD fail, unprovided); it never compares a run with the same run before the change. The unchangedness is carried by the existing suites staying green (3776 then 3809 passed), which the bound evidence does not name. I ran the checker on canon (L0 and L1) and on itself (L0): the levels are met with the same unsupported rows and one SHOULD fail (L1.one-meaning-values on --kind), and findings appear only on checks that did not pass. Blast radius: seeded_violations and atip_check_l1 were edited (3-4 lines each) to read kind; a wrong kind there would still pass them.
